ops.title: v14 _native.pyi generation: pyo3-stub-gen + merged single-file writer
ops.body:
# v14 _native.pyi generation

The committed `cc_transcript/_native.pyi` is MACHINE-GENERATED (user decision 2026-07-14, superseding the spec's hand-maintenance fallback): `cargo run -p cc-transcript-py --bin stub_gen` regenerates it; a drift gate asserts regenerate == committed.

**Why a custom writer over plain pyo3-stub-gen `generate()`:** the extension is one flat namespace (`cc_transcript._native`) whose pyclasses deliberately claim facade module strings (`module = "cc_transcript.models"` etc.) for reprs, pickling, and griffe docs resolution. pyo3-stub-gen groups stub output by those module strings: it would emit per-facade `__init__.py` re-export shims over our hand-written facades (models.py, tools.py) and refuses the pure-Rust single-file layout for multi-module inventories. The bin (`rust/crates/py/src/bin/stub_gen.rs`) instead merges every module group into one `Module`, renders it, de-qualifies references to merged class names (per-name `\bgroup\.Name\b` regex so facade-only aliases like `cc_transcript.tools.ToolCall` stay qualified), drops group imports with no remaining qualified use, and writes the single `_native.pyi`.

**Annotation rules (all-or-nothing per class):**
- Every `#[pyclass]` gets `#[pyo3_stub_gen::derive::gen_stub_pyclass]`; every `#[pymethods]` gets `#[pyo3_stub_gen::derive::gen_stub_pymethods]`. A gen_stub_pymethods block whose class lacks gen_stub_pyclass panics the gatherer ("Missing struct_id/enum_id").
- Getters returning `PyAny`/`PyTuple`/`PyDict` carry `#[gen_stub(override_return_type(type_repr = "...", imports = (...)))]` with the precise type; parameters that lack `PyStubType` (e.g. `&[u8]`) carry `#[gen_stub(override_type(type_repr = "bytes"))]`. Convention: type_reprs use the fully qualified runtime module string (`cc_transcript.models.EntryMeta`); the writer normalizes merged names, and non-merged facade refs (cc_transcript.ids, alias unions in tools) render qualified with their `import` retained.
- `view_dunders!` emits the annotated `__match_args__` classattr block — flipping this on requires EVERY view_dunders class to be gen_stub_pyclass-registered first (else the gatherer panics), so it went last in the adoption sweep.

**Spike facts (2026-07-14):** pyo3-stub-gen 0.23.0 works under pyo3 0.28 + abi3-py313 + `multiple-pymethods` + `extends =` chains + `frozen`; docstrings (Attributes: sections) flow verbatim; `Option<String>` → `typing.Optional[str]`; `#[new]` → typed `__new__`; non-subclass classes get `@typing.final`. The old claim that stub-gen "cannot generate this stub" was a never-run hunch inherited from a dead agent.
ops.when: regenerating or debugging cc_transcript/_native.pyi, adding a pyclass/pyfunction to the py crate, or re-evaluating the stub-generation approach
